# AiServe.my

> AiServe.my is the AI Business Operating System (Ai-BOS) by SLV Group Sdn Bhd — an AI solutions company in Malaysia building AI-powered systems for customer service, workflow automation, reporting, and operational intelligence.

AiServe.my helps businesses move beyond static software and isolated tools by connecting AI to real operations: WhatsApp AI customer service, internal AI assistants, automated workflows, quotations, and reporting — delivered as one practical, connected system (Ai-BOS).

Contact: WhatsApp +60 13-386 6827 · Email hello@aiserve.my
